478525.overview:
Yogi Bear is the head of the Lost and Found Squad in the Jellystone Mall. With the help of his friends, mysterious crimes are solved in fun and adventurous ways! This time Yogi has a real mystery on his hands and he needs your help! Play as Yogi through 4 fun filled stages in search of clues that will lead him to the missing person. Boo Boo, Snagglepuss and Huckleberry Hound will try to help too - but watch out for Dickie Dastardly and Roxy Bear! Can you guess who the missing person is?

Yogi's friends will point out clues to lead you to the missing person!

Help Yogi jump over Boo Boo's skateboard and Dickie Dastardly's marbles to score points!

Watch out! Roxy Bear will try to kiss Yogi!
